q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis of NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance

## (a) Time left until resolution
Today is 2026-08-13. NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 earnings are typically released in late August or early September. The guidance for Q2 FY2027 has **already been announced** on May 20, 2026, according to the research provided. There is essentially **0 time left** — this is not a forecast of a future event, but rather a question about an already-issued guidance figure.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The research explicitly states that **on May 20, 2026, NVIDIA announced forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue of $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%**.

This means the guidance range is:
- **Lower bound: $89.18 billion** ($91.0B × 0.98)
- **Upper bound: $92.82 billion** ($91.0B × 1.02)
- **Central figure: $91.0 billion**

The question asks "What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance" — the use of "will be" is technically asking about a future point-in-time, but since the guidance has already been issued, the answer is deterministic: **$91.0 billion** (with official guidance of $91.0B ±2%).

## (c) What would push the value lower?

This question is asking for a historical fact that has already occurred. However, if we consider uncertainty around whether:
- The reported figure is accurate (extremely unlikely — this comes from SEC filings)
- There was a revised/withdrawn guidance (the research shows the official guidance as $91.0B)

There is negligible downside uncertainty since this is a documented fact.

## (d) What would push the value higher?

Similarly, there is no mechanism to push the value higher since the guidance has been officially announced and filed with the SEC. The only theoretical uncertainty would be if there were subsequent revisions upward, but the research provides no indication of this.

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

The research provides:
- **Official NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 guidance: $91.0 billion ±2%** (source: investor.nvidia.com and SEC filing)
- Analyst consensus for Q2 FY2027: $91.8 billion (with range $90.3B to $96.7B)
- Q1 FY2027 actual revenue: $81.6 billion

The guidance of $91.0B represents an implied sequential growth of ~11.5% from Q1 FY2027's $81.6B, which is reasonable given NVIDIA's trajectory.

---

This is a question about an already-announced figure. NVIDIA's official forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, announced on May 20, 2026, is **$91.0 billion with a ±2% range ($89.18B to $92.82B)**.

The most appropriate probability distribution should be heavily concentrated around $91.0 billion, with the ±2% range reflecting NVIDIA's standard guidance practice.

q_45367.research_text: NVIDIA has already provided forward guidance for its Q2 FY2027 revenue. On May 20, 2026, when reporting Q1 FY2027 results, NVIDIA announced an outlook for Q2 FY2027 revenue to be $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). This guidance excludes any Data Center compute revenue from China [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). This figure is well above the average quarterly revenue estimate of $86.84 billion from LSEG analysts [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). Analysts' consensus for Q2 FY2027 revenue is $91.8 billion, with a low estimate of $90.3 billion and a high of $96.7 billion [tickerleague.com](https://tickerleague.com/companies/NVDA/estimates). NVIDIA's Q1 FY2027 revenue was $81.6 billion, an 85% increase year-over-year [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [barchart.com](https://www.barchart.com/story/news/3449043/what-to-expect-from-nvidia-s-q2-2027-earnings-report).
